name: Autodesk Revit
description: BIM software for coordinated architectural, structural and MEP design.
market: Dominant in the US; very strong in CH and DE; widespread in FR, especially in large firms and multidisciplinary practices.

name: Graphisoft Archicad
description: Architect-focused BIM authoring and documentation tool.
market: Strong in CH, DE and FR; particularly popular among architecture-led practices; meaningful but smaller US presence.

name: Autodesk AutoCAD
description: Industry-standard 2D drafting and 3D CAD.
market: Universal across all four markets; still foundational for documentation, engineering and legacy workflows.

name: Trimble SketchUp
description: Fast, intuitive 3D modelling for concepts and design communication.
market: Very broad adoption in all markets; especially common in early design, interiors and small practices.

name: Vectorworks
description: CAD/BIM platform strong in architecture, landscape and entertainment.
market: Strong in entertainment, landscape and architecture; notable in US and DE, with a solid European base.

name: Allplan
description: BIM/CAD software with strong detailing and construction documentation.
market: Particularly strong in DACH — Germany, Switzerland, Austria — with a meaningful French footprint; less common in the US.

name: BricsCAD
description: Cost-effective AutoCAD-compatible CAD platform.
market: Cost-conscious AutoCAD alternative; present across Europe including CH and DE, with growing but limited US adoption.

name: MicroStation
description: Bentley CAD/BIM platform for infrastructure and large projects.
market: Strong in civil, infrastructure, rail and large public projects; notable in US, DE and CH; specialized in FR.

name: Tekla Structures
description: Structural BIM for steel, concrete and fabrication detailing.
market: Strong among structural engineers and fabricators in all four markets; especially established in Nordic/DACH-influenced steel and concrete workflows.

name: FreeCAD
market: Global open-source community; useful for parametric/custom work, but limited mainstream AEC production adoption.

name: Rhino 3D
description: Precise NURBS modelling for complex geometry.
market: Very strong in architecture, industrial design and fabrication across FR, CH, DE and US.

name: Grasshopper
description: Visual programming for parametric and generative design; included with Rhino.
market: The default computational-design environment in leading architecture and engineering practices globally.
notes: ⚠ grasshopper3d.com is vendor-announced as being discontinued; the community moved to discourse.mcneel.com.

name: Blender
description: Open-source 3D modelling, animation and rendering.
market: Strong among visualization artists and smaller studios; increasingly used in architecture, though less embedded in BIM workflows.
buyer: visualization artists · small studios · open-source developers

name: Cinema 4D
description: 3D modelling and animation, popular in visualization.
market: Particularly strong in German-speaking markets and motion-design/visualization studios. Maxon is a Nemetschek subsidiary.

name: Autodesk 3ds Max
description: High-end 3D modelling, animation and rendering.
market: Established in high-end architectural visualization; strong in US and Europe.

name: Unreal Engine
description: Real-time 3D engine for interactive visualization and VR.
market: Used by advanced visualization teams, VR/AR workflows and large firms; global adoption. Epic Games.

name: Twinmotion
description: Fast real-time architectural visualization.
market: Accessible real-time rendering option with broad international adoption, especially where Archicad/Revit users need fast output. Epic Games, powered by Unreal Engine.

name: Autodesk Forma
market: Newer Autodesk platform; strongest where firms are already Autodesk-centric, including US, UK and parts of Europe.

name: Rayon
description: Collaborative online CAD for architectural drawings.
market: European, architecture-first; appealing to smaller studios and design-led teams in FR, CH and DE.

name: Snaptrude
description: Browser-based collaborative building modelling.
market: Early traction with tech-forward architecture teams; strongest visibility in US and India-led international markets.

name: Arcol
description: Web-native architectural modelling and presentation tool.
market: Early-stage, design-forward; mostly innovation teams and startups rather than mainstream production.

name: Motif
description: Collaborative, web-based design and documentation platform.
market: Emerging platform; early adopters in US and European tech-oriented practices.

name: Qonic
description: Cloud BIM/modelling platform for collaborative building design.
market: Early-stage European-origin platform; potential relevance in CH/DE/FR, but still niche.

name: That Open Platform
description: Open-source infrastructure for openBIM apps and data.
market: Global developer/open-source ecosystem; relevant wherever IFC/openBIM is prioritized, including CH, DE and FR.

name: Giraffe
description: Cloud platform for site planning and urban design.
market: More common in planning, masterplanning and proptech contexts; strongest early traction in anglophone markets.

name: Spacio
description: Data-driven design and AEC workflow platform.
market: Emerging; likely relevant to data-driven practices rather than broad market adoption.

name: Hypar
description: Generative design platform for building systems and layouts.
market: Specialist generative-design platform; adoption among advanced computational teams, especially in the US. Pivoted away from computational design in 2024.

name: Finch
description: AI-assisted generative floorplan and layout design.
market: Early-stage AI/generative design; interest from architecture firms exploring automation.

name: Augmenta
description: AI automation for building design and engineering — starting with electrical, extending into MEP.
market: Early-stage automation for building systems/design; primarily innovation-led adoption. Distinct from the unrelated agritech company acquired by CNH in 2023.

name: Branch3D
market: Niche/early-stage; market presence likely limited and project-specific. Incubated within StructureCraft, Vancouver.

name: ETABS
description: Structural analysis and design of buildings.
market: Strong in US and international high-rise/building engineering; used by specialized structural firms in Europe.

name: Dlubal RFEM
description: FEM structural analysis and design software.
market: Very strong in DACH — especially Germany and Switzerland — and increasingly used elsewhere in Europe.

name: IDEA StatiCa
description: Steel connection and structural joint design.
market: Strong among structural engineers and fabricators in Europe including CH, DE and FR; growing US adoption.

name: MagiCAD
market: Especially established in Northern Europe and DACH; relevant where Revit-based MEP design is standardized.

name: Speckle
description: Open platform for sharing and versioning AEC model data.
market: Strong with computational and openBIM-oriented teams globally; growing in CH, DE, FR and US.
notes: ⚠ Funding figures conflict across sources (Suffolk Technologies investment, Apr 2026).

name: IfcOpenShell
description: Open-source toolkit for reading, writing and processing IFC.
market: Global open-source standard for IFC automation; used by BIM managers and developers.

name: Bonsai
description: Open-source BIM authoring built on Blender.
market: Emerging Blender-based BIM workflow; niche but relevant to openBIM communities in Europe.

name: xBIM Toolkit
description: .NET toolkit for building IFC/BIM applications.
market: Developer-oriented; used in custom BIM solutions rather than by typical design teams.

name: xFigura
description: AI-powered BIM data and model intelligence tool; collaborative AI canvas with Rhino/Revit integrations.
market: Early-stage; likely niche adoption.

name: Synaps
description: AI tool that imports DXF/PDF, drafts documentation and generates floor plans.
market: Early-stage/niche.

name: Arkyv
description: AI platform for architectural project data and archives — BIM task automation, code/standards search with citations.
market: Early-stage/niche.
notes: ⚠ arkyv.org is an unrelated text-world engine.

name: AIRI lab
description: AI research and tools for the built environment — concept generation, cloud generative 3D, agentic workflows.
market: Early-stage/niche.

name: Reer
description: Agentic layer automating Rhino, Grasshopper and Revit workflows.
market: Early-stage/niche.
notes: ⚠ Canonical domain is reer.co, not reer.ai.

name: Versur
market: Early-stage/niche.

name: D5 Render
description: Real-time architectural rendering and visualization, with live links to Revit/SketchUp/Rhino.
market: Growing challenger, with increasing adoption among younger visualization teams internationally.

name: Enscape
description: Real-time rendering plugin for Revit, Archicad, SketchUp and Rhino.
market: Very strong in architecture practices across US, CH, DE and FR; common because of Revit/Archicad integration.

name: V-Ray
description: High-end photorealistic rendering engine.
market: Established globally among visualization specialists and larger firms.

name: Lumion
description: Fast architectural rendering and animation.
market: Broad architectural adoption in Europe and the US; especially popular for fast external visuals.

name: Veras
description: AI-enhanced architectural rendering and image iteration, driven from Revit, Rhino, SketchUp, Archicad or Vectorworks.
market: Early-stage AI visualization; adoption among firms experimenting with AI workflows.

name: Rendair
description: AI-generated architectural visuals and renderings from sketches, plans and models.
market: Early-stage; likely strongest among smaller studios and marketing/competition workflows. An AI renderer, not distributed-compute rendering.

name: Visoid
description: AI visualization for architectural concepts, preserving imported model geometry.
market: Early-stage/niche. $2.5M round, Aug 2026.

name: Gendo
market: Early-stage/niche.

name: Narva AI
description: AI assistant/tooling for AEC workflows — renders, style transfer, video and 3D.
market: Early-stage/niche.

name: FORMAS.AI
description: AI platform turning sketches into 2D visuals, 3D models and client-ready boards.
market: Early-stage; market presence still forming.

name: Runway
description: AI video and image generation/editing and world models.

name: Nano Banana
description: Google DeepMind's Gemini image generation and editing models.
market: General-purpose AI imaging; not AEC-specific.
notes: ⚠ A model, not a product — increasingly embedded in other tools.

name: Midjourney
description: AI image generator for concepts and visual exploration.
market: Very widely used for early concept imagery across all markets.

name: Leonardo AI
description: AI image-generation platform for creative workflows.
market: General creative AI; used for moodboards and concept exploration.

name: Adobe Firefly
description: Adobe's generative AI for images and creative content.
market: Broad creative-market adoption; useful for concept and marketing imagery.

name: Krea
description: AI creative tool for realtime image generation, editing and enhancement.
market: Early-stage creative AI; niche in AEC.

name: Figma Weave
description: Node-based canvas combining many AI models for image/video/motion.
market: More product/UX-oriented than AEC-specific; relevant to digital design teams.

name: ComfyUI
description: Node-based interface for building custom AI image workflows.
market: Technical/creative users building custom AI pipelines; niche but powerful.

name: Magnific
description: AI image upscaling and detail enhancement.
market: Used by visualization studios globally for post-production enhancement.
notes: ⚠ Domain changed from magnific.ai (now a legacy portal for existing accounts); magnifi.ai is an unrelated company.

name: Meshy
market: Emerging; useful for concept massing, assets and game-like environments rather than construction documentation.

name: Pirros

description: Platform for reusing architectural details and firm knowledge.

name: Tektome

name: Freeda

description: AI assistant for architecture practice workflows; flags project-file risks and compliance issues.
market: Early-stage/niche.

name: Kinship

name: JOOC

market: Early-stage/niche.

name: Raygister
category: Practice Operations & AI for AEC Firms
market: Early-stage/niche.

name: NavVis

name: Cintoo

name: Trimble Connect

market: Broad adoption across construction and MEP workflows; strong in US and Europe.

name: OpenSpace

name: Buildots

name: Fieldwire
